outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured microscopy images (micrographs), not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows scatter/line plots of normalized intensity over time, where each plotted marker is itself an individual raw measurement (not a bar/mean summary), with fitted model curves overlaid. This plot type (scatter/line plot showing raw data points directly) is exempt from requiring additional individual data point overlays.
